home.title: Chess trainer
home.subtitle: Play Stockfish with a coach that explains every mistake, or drill your openings move by move.
home.playDesc: Pick a level from beginner to full strength. After each move the coach rates it, explains what went wrong and shows the best move.
home.engineLoading: The engine (≈7 MB) downloads the first time you open a board.

board.engineFailed: The chess engine failed to load. Check your connection and reload the page.

play.title: Play vs Stockfish
play.aiToggle: Let the AI assistant explain my mistakes
play.aiToggleHelp: Off by default: the coach relies only on Stockfish. When on, an “Ask the AI coach” button appears after mistakes.

coach.title: Coach
coach.empty: Make a move — the coach will review it here.
coach.viewingBefore: Position before your move. Green = best, red = yours.
coach.aiPrompt: I'm training chess. Position (FEN) before my move: {{fen}}. I played {{played}} as {{color}}. Stockfish rates it a {{quality}} ({{before}} → {{after}}). The best move was {{best}}, with the line {{line}}. Explain in simple terms why my move is worse and what idea I should remember.

notes.missedMate: You had a forced mate in {{n}} starting with {{move}}.
notes.allowsMate: This allows a forced mate in {{n}}: {{line}}.
notes.refutationCheck: Your opponent answers {{move}} with a strong check.
notes.playedBest: That's exactly what the engine would play.
